name: Repair the WMI repository
summary: Checks the WMI repository for consistency and, only if it is inconsistent, salvages it. It never resets the repository.
risk_note: A consistent repository is left untouched. Salvaging merges what can be read into a rebuilt repository and briefly restarts WMI, which can interrupt monitoring and management tools for a moment. If salvage is not enough the run fails and says so: resetting the repository (which discards every third-party WMI registration) is deliberately left to a person.

windows: Only if that reports an inconsistent repository: runs winmgmt /salvagerepository and verifies again.
